We need to extract SMILES of the unknown sample. We have many tools: we can get spectra (mass spec, NMR, IR) to deduce structure. But we want efficient minimal experiments. Perhaps we can use mass spectrometry first to get molecular weight, then maybe get formula via isotopic distribution, then maybe get fragments. But we need SMILES. Could also use search_by_smiles with unknown? No.

We need to infer SMILES from data, but we have no data provided. The prompt only says "You are operating in a lab with a sample of an organic compound. Extract its SMILES string efficiently". No experimental data given. So we need to actually perform experiments to get data. But we want minimal cost. Perhaps we can first get mass spec to get molecular weight. Then maybe get formula via DBE? But we need more info.

We could try to get mass spec first. Use mass_spectrometry_spectra tool.
